verdict.rationale: OCI's own docs describe official SDKs for building and deploying apps that integrate with OCI services. Each SDK comes with code samples and documentation for creating, testing and troubleshooting, and a Java SDK for Select AI is also named. The APIs underneath are standard REST over HTTPS. Missing for 10: an explicit enumeration of supported SDK languages in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Software Development Kits (SDKs) Build and deploy apps that integrate with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services.
Each SDK provides the tools you need to develop an app, including code samples and documentation to create, test, and troubleshoot.
Select AI for Java provides a Java SDK for using Select AI capabilities in Java applications.
